text: The Insurance and Risk Finance Initiative for Nepal is a national engagement under the UNDP's Insurance & Risk Finance Facility (IRFF), aimed at expanding inclusive insurance and strengthening disaster risk financing (DRF) in Nepal. The initiative involves a comprehensive diagnostic to map priority hazards, review the insurance and DRF landscape, and identify legal instruments to support the expansion of insurance coverage and risk financing. It emphasizes strategic moves such as expanding distribution channels, building public-sector capacity, addressing disaster risk assessment gaps, and leveraging existing government-subsidized agriculture insurance.
